metadata.description: Regional performance investigation focusing on part quality issues and return rates

turns.content: Our quality team reported an increase in product returns. Can you investigate return patterns?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing return data

turns.content: Show me the distribution of return flags across all lineitems.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show count by L_RETURNFLAG

turns.content: For all return analysis, only consider items with status 'O' (ordered/shipped).
Now show me returns by region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show return rates by customer region

turns.content: EUROPE has the highest return rate. Which nations in Europe?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should break down by nation

turns.content: FRANCE and GERMANY have highest returns. Use O_ORDERDATE for all date filtering in this analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Exclude all orders from before 1994 from this analysis.
Show me the suppliers of these frequently-returned parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to SUPPLIER table

turns.content: Remember the return distribution we looked at earlier? Can you show that again but only for Europe?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the return distribution we looked at earlier
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recreate return by region for Europe only

turns.content: From now on, exclude AIR mode from our analysis.
What was the return count for Germany in March?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall or recalculate March Germany returns

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me the top 10 parts by return rate.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: L_LINESTATUS='O', O_ORDERDATE>=1994, exclude AIR

turns.content: Earlier we saw that FRANCE had high returns. What was the exact return rate?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall France return rate

turns.content: Show me a final breakdown with all filters: returns by nation, supplier, and part type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive filtered analysis

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that return issues are concentrated in Europe, particularly France and Germany, driven by specific suppliers and high-discount items.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and confirm findings

anaphoricReferences.phrase: the return distribution we looked at earlier
